module_role: J601/J604/J608/J610 source-bounded BAS network, VFD, valve and I/O context.

assertions.expected: ACHE BYPASS A MODULATING VALVE FEEDBACK
ACHE BYPASS A MODULATING VALVE POSITION
NEW ACHE BYPASS CONTROLLER CM-61 EXP-01

published_integration: J601 is a Building Automation Network Riser Diagram. It visibly identifies BACnet/IP, BACnet/MS/TP, CMnet, Modbus, named TCP panels, CM controllers, ME stacks and Ethernet connections.
J604 maps CWGP VFD points and labels BACnet. J610 identifies new ACHE bypass controller CM-61 expansion panels.
network_architecture.boundary: The riser/diagrams do not establish final sitewide device addresses, complete BACnet object database, field-wiring takeoff, commissioned as-built ownership, final controller/card/terminal counts or all physical device quantities.

sensors_and_control_symbol_context.published_context: Controls diagrams publish CWGP VFD enable/speed/speed feedback/kW/HOA/fault, suction/discharge pressure, valve feedback/position and fan-status contexts.
sensors_and_control_symbol_context.boundary: These are source diagram/point-map contexts and are not converted into standalone physical sensor, actuator, valve, zone or I/O counts.
